name: opencode-axiom
description: Axiom platform extension plugin for OpenCode — enterprise observability, session sharing, config-driven automation, and progressive onboarding

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external zod --external @opencode-ai/plugin && bun build src/plugin.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external zod --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external yaml && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.dev: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external zod --external @opencode-ai/plugin --watch
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run typecheck
scripts.check:hub-size: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const lines=fs.readFileSync('src/index.ts','utf8').split('\n').length;if(lines>1000){console.error('index.ts has '+lines+' lines (limit: 1000). Consider extracting tool execute() bodies into tools.ts.');process.exit(1);}else{console.log('index.ts: '+lines+' lines (limit: 1000) ✓');}"
scripts.check:arch: bun run check:circular && bun run check:hub-size

_optionalDependenciesNote: Install @aws-sdk/client-cloudwatch to enable the CloudWatch metrics sink. Without it, the CloudWatch sink gracefully degrades to stdout logging.
